question.problem:
Expressed as a single fraction, the exact area of the plot of land is$\,${{field-1}}
${\text{mi}}^{2}.$
question.worked_solution:
The exact area of land is ${(\frac{4}{5})}^{2}\,{\text{mi}}^{2}.$

Writing ${(\frac{4}{5})}^{2}$ with multiplication signs, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}{(\frac{4}{5})}^{2} & ={{\frac{4}{5}\times \frac{4}{5}}_{⏟}}_{2\text{ times}} \\  & =\frac{4\times 4}{5\times 5} \\  & =\frac{16}{25}.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore,

$$
{(\frac{4}{5})}^{2}=\frac{16}{25}.
$$
